name: Konomi Rayla
source:
"Isn’t this a self-introduction?"
"As long as we tell each other what we want isn’t it fine?" 

Position: Solider
Weapon: Poison needle

He likes to watch the stars and the planets.
Unlike Yun who is the friendly type, he is the complete opposite.
His attitude towards others is cold and he uses offensive language, because of this the teammates refer to him as “ice man”.
He set an oath to himself stating "I will never kill the Target", which is the reason why he uses the only weapon in the team which does not kill the target.

[Edited from [url=http://cannonette.tumblr.com/post/90317810847/binary-star-main-characters]Cannonette[/url]]
